hints: `type(of: self)` and `Self` refer to the object's runtime type.
`pet` is a `Dog` stored in an `Animal` variable, so it describes and clones itself as a `Dog`.
jsBridge: `self` is the instance, `Self` is the instance's type (dynamic in classes), and `type(of:)` gets the runtime type. JS has `this` and `this.constructor`, and Swift's `Self` is the typed version of the latter.
